text: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.
reflection: What would it mean to trust that you are cared for today?
prayer: Ask for guidance and contentment for today.

text: Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding.
reflection: Where could you release the need to control every outcome?
prayer: Ask for wisdom to take the next faithful step.

text: Take therefore no thought for the morrow: for the morrow shall take thought for the things of itself.
reflection: What concern can you set down for this moment?
prayer: Ask for presence and courage for today.

text: Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God.
reflection: Name one concern and one thing for which you are thankful.
prayer: Offer your concern honestly and ask for peace.

text: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
reflection: When have you experienced help in a difficult moment?
prayer: Ask for strength, and remember someone who needs support.

text: Have not I commanded thee? Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed: for the LORD thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest.
reflection: What brave and kind action can you take today?
prayer: Ask for courage for one specific challenge.

text: Rejoicing in hope; patient in tribulation; continuing instant in prayer;
reflection: Which part of this verse feels most needed today?
prayer: Give thanks for a hope you can hold onto.

text: And let us not be weary in well doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.
reflection: What good effort deserves another patient step?
prayer: Ask for steadiness in doing what is right.

text: He hath shewed thee, O man, what is good; and what doth the LORD require of thee, but to do justly, and to love mercy, and to walk humbly with thy God?
reflection: Choose one way to practice justice, mercy, or humility today.
prayer: Ask for a humble heart and a merciful response.

text: Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
reflection: What burden might you share rather than carry alone?
prayer: Ask for rest and the willingness to receive it.

text: O taste and see that the LORD is good: blessed is the man that trusteth in him.
reflection: Notice one small sign of goodness around you.
prayer: Give thanks for a good thing you noticed today.

text: But they that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint.
reflection: What kind of rest or renewal would help you continue?
prayer: Ask for renewed strength at the pace you need.

text: I am the vine, ye are the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same bringeth forth much fruit: for without me ye can do nothing.
reflection: What practice helps you stay connected to what matters?
prayer: Ask for help to stay rooted and attentive.

text: Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.
reflection: Name one care you are carrying today.
prayer: Offer that care in prayer and consider who can support you.

text: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.
reflection: What good can you work toward in the situation before you?
prayer: Ask for hope and wise action amid uncertainty.

text: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.
reflection: What is one next step you can see clearly?
prayer: Ask for light for the next step, not the whole road.

text: And whatsoever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men;
reflection: How could you bring care to one ordinary task today?
prayer: Ask for sincerity and care in your work.

text: Commit thy works unto the LORD, and thy thoughts shall be established.
reflection: What plan would you like to commit to prayer?
prayer: Offer your work and ask for clear priorities.

text: Let us run with patience the race that is set before us,
reflection: What distraction could you lay aside for one focused hour?
prayer: Ask for patience to continue at a healthy pace.

text: Charity suffereth long, and is kind; charity envieth not; charity vaunteth not itself, is not puffed up,
reflection: Who could benefit from your patient kindness today?
prayer: Ask for love that is patient and kind.

text: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
reflection: Where do you need wisdom rather than a quick answer?
prayer: Ask for wisdom and listen before acting.

text: Create in me a clean heart, O God; and renew a right spirit within me.
reflection: What would you like to begin again with honesty?
prayer: Ask for renewal and a willing spirit.

text: Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven.
reflection: What quiet good can you do without seeking recognition?
prayer: Ask to be generous with your gifts.

text: Rejoice evermore. Pray without ceasing. In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.
reflection: What small reminder could help you return to gratitude today?
prayer: Offer three brief moments of thanks throughout your day.

text: For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.
reflection: What would a loving and clear-minded response look like?
prayer: Ask for courage guided by love and sound judgment.

text: Commit thy way unto the LORD; trust also in him; and he shall bring it to pass.
reflection: What path are you choosing, one step at a time?
prayer: Ask for trust and patience as you follow through.

text: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus unto good works, which God hath before ordained that we should walk in them.
reflection: What good work fits your abilities and the needs around you?
prayer: Give thanks for a gift you can use in service.

text: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.
reflection: What hope can help you keep moving without certainty?
prayer: Ask for faith and patience in the unknown.

text: Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.
reflection: What can you do to make room for peace today?
prayer: Ask for peace, and offer reassurance to someone else.

text: And God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes; and there shall be no more death, neither sorrow, nor crying, neither shall there be any more pain.
reflection: What does comfort and hope mean to you today?
prayer: Remember those who are grieving and ask for comfort for them.
